newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 grain imports down 42 pct-newspaper.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 grain imports down 42 pct-newspaper.

text.p: China's grain imports fell 42 percent last year to 12 million tonnes while exports rose by 42.3 percent to 1.43 million tonnes, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.

However, a European Union decision to levy additional tariffs on wheat and flour exports had contributed to a decline in China's wheat imports by 28.3 percent to 8.3 million tonnes, it said, quoting figures from the State Statistical Bureau.

Grain exports were also affected by the cut in the export tariff rebate for agricultural products to three percent from seven percent, the newspaper said, but added that this had enabled the government to boost reserves.
China imported 440,000 tonnes of corn, and exported 159,000 tonnes in 1996, it said.
Imports of rice were 761,000 tonnes while exports were 264,000 tonnes, it said.
Soybean imports were 1.11 million tonnes while exports were 191,000 tonnes, it said.
